fields.help_en:
The address type. Valid values:

Object storage: `oss`, `s3`, `qiniu`, `cos`, `bos`, `obs`, `ks3`, `ucloud`, `upyun`, `azure`, `gcp`, and `tos`.

File storage: `local`, `obsfs`, and `ftp`.

Inventory: `inv`

对象存储：oss，s3，qiniu，cos，bos，obs，ks3，ucloud，upyun，azure，gcp，tos。

文件存储：local，obsfs，ftp。

清单：inv

fields.help_en:
The name of the data address.\
The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (). The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length. The name is case-sensitive and encoded in UTF-8. The name cannot start with a hyphen (-) or an underscore (). You must specify a name
fields.help_zh:
数据地址名称。  
取值：英文小写字母、数字和特殊字符-和_，最短 3 字符， 最长 63 个字符，区分大小写，utf8 编码并且不可以- 和_开头，不能为空
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The tags in the key:value format.\
The value can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and commas (,). The value can be up to 1,024 characters in length
fields.help_zh:
标签，KeyValue格式。   
允许字符：英文大小写字母、数字和特殊字符-_,。长度限制：1KB
